champion.tips: YUNARA TIPS AND TRICKS Keep auto-attacking and maintaining 8 stacks on your Q at all times. Doing so will help you when it comes to all-ining the enemy. Make sure you get level 2 first in lane, and have 8 stacks on your Q . Then when you get the level up, unlock your W, press it to slow the enemy ADC or Support down and then go for an early skirmish. In team fights, keep an eye on your positioning and be prepared to E over walls to escape bad situations.
champion.builds: THE BEST YUNARA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Yunara Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Kraken Slayer as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Runaan's Hurricane. For your last 3 items, you should build Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards and finish with Immortal Shieldbow. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 48.9% winrate over 31 858 matches played. Optional Your second option for Yunara Bot build would be to take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Yun Tal Wildarrows, which you should build first, followed by Berserker's Greaves as your second item and Runaan's Hurricane as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards and Bloodthirster. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 46.9% win rate over 2 575 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then Berserker's Greaves as a second item and Runaan's Hurricane as a third item. You want to finish the build with Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards and Immortal Shieldbow. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 47.9% win rate across 2 349 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Yunara Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Press the Attack, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down as your primary rune tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Gathering Storm as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Kraken Slayer as your first item, then finish Berserker's Greaves as your second item, and Runaan's Hurricane as third item. The last 3 options are Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards and Bloodthirster. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 40.7% win rate over 459 matches played. Situational Yunara Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Yunara build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Yunara runes page.
